+def parse_sse_text(
+    text: str, *, event_names: frozenset[str] | None = None
+) -> list[SSEEvent]:
+    # SSE uses CR/LF framing; Unicode line separators can occur inside JSON text.
+    events: list[SSEEvent] = []
+    current_event = ""
+    data_parts: list[str] = []
+    raw_parts: list[str] = []
+    start = 0
+    pos = 0
+    length = len(text)
+
+    while pos < length:
+        char = text[pos]
+        if char == "\r" or char == "\n":
+            stripped = text[start:pos]
+            if char == "\r" and pos + 1 < length and text[pos + 1] == "\n":
+                pos += 1
+            if stripped == "":
+                _append_event(events, current_event, data_parts, raw_parts, event_names)
+                current_event = ""
+                data_parts = []
+                raw_parts = []
+            else:
+                raw_parts.append(stripped)
+                if stripped.startswith("event:"):
+                    current_event = stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+                elif stripped.startswith("data:"):
+                    data_parts.append(stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
+            start = pos + 1
+        pos += 1
+
+    stripped = text[start:length]
+    if stripped == "":
+        _append_event(events, current_event, data_parts, raw_parts, event_names)
+    else:
+        raw_parts.append(stripped)
+        if stripped.startswith("event:"):
+            current_event = stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+        elif stripped.startswith("data:"):
+            data_parts.append(stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
+        _append_event(events, current_event, data_parts, raw_parts, event_names)
+    return events
+

actions.reason: Avoid running the SSE boundary regex for chunks that contain no line terminators, and replace colon splitting with fixed-prefix slicing when parsing event and data fields. This reduces work in the decoder hot path without changing parsed events or raw frame output.

+++ b/src/free_claude_code/core/anthropic/stream_contracts.py
@@ -66,9 +66,9 @@ def parse_sse_lines(
             continue
         raw_parts.append(stripped)
         if stripped.startswith("event:"):
-            current_event = stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
+            current_event = stripped[6:].strip()
         elif stripped.startswith("data:"):
-            data_parts.append(stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
+            data_parts.append(stripped[5:].strip())
 
     _append_event(events, current_event, data_parts, raw_parts, event_names)
     return events
diff --git a/src/free_claude_code/core/anthropic/streaming/decoder.py b/src/free_claude_code/core/anthropic/streaming/decoder.py
--- a/src/free_claude_code/core/anthropic/streaming/decoder.py
+++ b/src/free_claude_code/core/anthropic/streaming/decoder.py
@@ -27,6 +27,11 @@ class AnthropicSSEDecoder:
     def feed_frames(self, chunk: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
         """Retain original framing, including comments and unknown SSE fields."""
 
+        if chunk and "\n" not in chunk and "\r" not in chunk:
+            self._parts.append(chunk)
+            self._boundary_tail = (self._boundary_tail + chunk)[-3:]
+            return ()

         frames: list[str] = []
         probe = self._boundary_tail + chunk
         prefix_length = len(self._boundary_tail)
